title: Find the account IDs of clients who made credit card withdrawals in 1998 wi
question: Find the account IDs of clients who made credit card withdrawals in 1998 with transaction amounts below the 1998 average and reside in districts where the average salary is between $8000 and $9000. For each such account, also return the gap between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts.

prediction.sql:
WITH avg_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(XCL_051) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998'
    AND XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
),
salary_gap AS (
  SELECT MAX(XCL_027) - MIN(XCL_027) AS gap
  FROM district
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001, sg.gap
FROM account a
INNER JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
INNER JOIN card c ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
INNER JOIN trans t ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
INNER JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
CROSS JOIN avg_1998 av
CROSS JOIN salary_gap sg
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.XCL_051 < av.avg_amount
  AND dist.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

WITH avg_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(XCL_051) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998'
    AND XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
),
salary_gap AS (
  SELECT MAX(XCL_027) - MIN(XCL_027) AS gap
  FROM district
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001, sg.gap
FROM account a
INNER JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
INNER JOIN card c ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
INNER JOIN trans t ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
INNER JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
CROSS JOIN avg_1998 av
CROSS JOIN salary_gap sg
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.XCL_051 < av.avg_amount
  AND dist.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE 
    t.XCL_053 = 'credit card'
    AND t.XCL_049 = 'withdrawal'
    AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
    AND t.XCL_055 < (
        SELECT AVG(XCL_055) 
        FROM trans

          AND XCL_049 = 'withdrawal' 
          AND strftime('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998'
    )
    AND dc.XCL_028 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH avg_1998 AS (
  SELECT AVG(XCL_051) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998'
    AND XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
),
salary_gap AS (
  SELECT MAX(XCL_027) - MIN(XCL_027) AS gap
  FROM district
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001, sg.gap
FROM account a
INNER JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
INNER JOIN card c ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
INNER JOIN trans t ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
INNER JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
CROSS JOIN avg_1998 av
CROSS JOIN salary_gap sg
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.XCL_051 < av.avg_amount
  AND dist.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
